speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To begin my assessment, how many weeks pregnant are you, and have you been in contact with anyone who has recently had a flu-like illness?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeria Monocytogenes Infection (Listeriosis). The combination of fever, headache, anorexia, and malaise in a 30-week pregnant patient with a specific history of consuming ice cream three days prior is highly suggestive of this foodborne illness. I will recommend immediate hospital admission for isolation and treatment with intravenous antibiotics.
